weights.unknown: Retain all fixed weights. Missing/unreliable evidence is UNKNOWN. If any critical-possible business atom is UNKNOWN, prospective score_interval lower bound is min(known PASS points, proven cap, 50), while the uncapped diagnostic interval retains PASS points..PASS+UNKNOWN. Upper applies only a proved cap. E0 is noncritical and alone does not lower the bound to 50.
weights.representation: D/P-E0 carries 5 points. Actual missing required response/package is noncritical FAIL. E1 carries 5.

driver_api.runAcceptanceTest: runAcceptanceTest({page, proxy, test, kind, source, draft, binding, artifactDir, observe, fixtureReplacements, timeout})
driver_api.observe: Evaluator-private frozen function receives actual captures/actions/host events/network ledger; returns assertion records. Missing observer stays UNKNOWN.
driver_api.context: Create a fresh BrowserContext and fresh startProxy session for every test; service workers blocked. Keep deny-by-default routes until context.close.
driver_api.routing: Allow only startProxy.origin plus its exact six allowedPaths. Local renderer Blob/data resources and local CSV downloads are not external transmission. Opaque iframe sandbox excludes allow-same-origin; CSP restricts external resources.
driver_api.evaluation: Frame evaluate is read-only DOM capture. Outer evaluate invokes only the already declared private observer/control API; it never sets candidate state or inserts expected values.
driver_api.teardown: Close browser context before/while closing proxy. Do not remove route guards while candidate page is still live.
driver_api.observer_module: runtime/acceptance-observer.mjs exports observe and observeAcceptance (same function)
driver_api.launcher: runCI uses official preinstalled channel chrome; exact expected version defaults to parent-probed 154.0.8037.97. Actual binary SHA256 is measured via CDP browser PID and /proc/exe; optional frozen binary hash is verified. Browser receives only the fixed minimal environment whitelist, no credential environment.

neutral_batch_template: Import Playwright and the fixed runtime server/driver from evaluator code, never candidate package scripts.
For each preregistered test, startProxy with the fixed source files and fresh synthetic store; create a fresh browser context with serviceWorkers='block'.

Call runAcceptanceTest with standard Playwright Page and the exact runtime allowedPaths. Real locators click/fill/selectOption/press create browser events.
Private host controls schedule held/failed responses and change synthetic authority; exact schedule/fixture data stay outside the opaque Frame.
Observer compares visible facts, local/submitted/authoritative snapshots and host request/result/commit ledger, then emits PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN with evidence refs.
Persist receipt JSON, manifest SHA256, host ledger, actual download bytes, DOM snapshots and PNGs. Review all relevant PNGs without claiming human review.
Register only this trusted manifest in score_ui_acceptance; preserve unknown weights and critical_pending.

business_rules: Identity comes from literal team_id/ticket_id, not display names. Disambiguate colliding labels for users.
A created-date interval is UTC [created_from, created_to): start included, end excluded. Initial bounds come from the source manifest; all teams and all statuses are initially selected.
ticket_count counts all matching records. Active means OPEN, IN_PROGRESS or WAITING; CLOSED is not active.
overdue_active_count counts active records with due_at strictly before source as_of. Equality is not overdue; do not use the browser clock.
remaining_effort_hours is the sum of remaining_minutes on active matching records divided by 60. Units must be clear; display rounding may not change stored/filter business meaning.
The chart shows matching active counts for OPEN, IN_PROGRESS and WAITING, including zero categories. Activating a bar selects that status scope and updates controls/table/metrics/chart together.
A successful no-match scope has an empty table and zero relevant metrics/chart. It is not a read error.
During pending/failed loads preserve requested filters. Retained previous results must be visibly identified as prior scope/revision; they must not be claimed as results of newer filters.
Retry performs a new permitted read for current intent. Old response/error completion cannot change newer results/error state.
Refresh preserves still-valid filters; if an entity actually disappears, an explicit explained invalidation may choose a valid default rather than keep a nonexistent identity.

Initial source data is loaded with readFile(./dataset.json). Scope changes, Refresh and Retry invoke declared deterministic load-data with stable-ID scope input; returned echoed scope binds the response to that request. An equivalent request-management architecture is accepted if actual source calls and latest-intent behavior meet these rules.

Function scope team_ids=[] means all teams; statuses=[] means no statuses. The team select all-teams option value is the empty string. Status controls use the complete public enum. Date input controls use YYYY-MM-DD values; displayed equivalent calendar wording is allowed.

Dates/free wording unresolved mechanically remain UNKNOWN for source-bound review, without locale guessing.

business_rules: Source resource_id, team_id, work_item_id and existing allocation_id are literal identity keys; similar human names do not merge entities.
Residual committed capacity for a resource/day equals available_minutes minus committed_minutes. Existing original capacity columns continue to show this source fact.
Tentative draft allocations are separate from committed work. Their cumulative minutes for each resource/day cannot exceed residual committed capacity.
Cumulative draft minutes for each work item cannot exceed its source remaining_minutes, including lines already in the draft.
Each allocation requires a source resource in the work item team, a matching required_skill, and a roster date within earliest_date through due_date inclusive.
Allocation minutes must be positive finite integers divisible by 15. Reject invalid quantity; do not silently round or change the user request.
View filters/search/reset/expanded details do not discard local draft lines. The plan editor date and old view date may differ; neither silently changes the other.
An explicit permitted Save submits the selected local snapshot under the actual verified revision/capability contract. A successful draft save does not alter committed_minutes or book a resource.
Invalid local input is not an authoritative store write. A predeclared read-only source must disable or refuse Save. A real midflight read-only rejection is respected without an alternate bypass.

A revision conflict preserves local edits and current authoritative state. Show a useful conflict/review path; never auto-retry with a new revision to overwrite authority or silently replace local edits.
Reviewing the latest authoritative draft/revision does not itself discard local edits or submit them. Reapply/discard requires a new explicit user decision.
A late success acknowledges exactly the snapshot submitted. Newer local edits remain unsaved and cannot be overwritten or marked saved by that older acknowledgement.
Failure retains local edits and a truthful dirty/error state; retrying a write requires explicit user Save and the verified currently permitted revision, not an automatic fallback.
Preserve original resource-ID sort and actual CSV export of the filtered/sorted capacity view; the export is a local download, not an external transmission.

Load the existing ./draft.json and use its exact returned revision and canWrite. Save only that existing file in the same Frame package; null read results do not authorize creating replacement files or guessing a permission/error cause.

While a save is pending, repeated clicks cannot create duplicate commits. Success requires a confirmed new revision and independently verified stored contents; a success label alone is not persistence evidence.

save_failed is an unconfirmed save outcome, not proof that authority is unchanged. Retain local edits and re-read the actual file to determine whether the submitted snapshot was stored before an explicit further Save. Never auto-retry blindly or overwrite using a constructed revision.

draft_id identifies the existing source draft and remains unchanged. Editing an existing allocation preserves its allocation_id; explicit removal and adding a new line may use a new stable unique local key. Identity rules are source-bound, not hidden generated-ID expectations.
planner.visible_value_contract: Public cell/preview roles identify actual visible values. They do not mandate reference column order or exact sentences. Use actual data-eval-field role and display data-eval-unit, or supported unambiguous visible headers/text fallback. Attributes alone cannot prove truth. Dates/free wording unresolved mechanically remain UNKNOWN for source-bound review, without locale guessing.

ci_config_binding: Coordinator hostMetadata covers exactly source file keys, each with positive opaque revision string and boolean canWrite. Unwritable public source cannot be granted write permission. Fixture digest binds raw file bytes and authority metadata; frozen coordinator digest map preferred.

fail_only_build_rejection_rule.requires: Closed CandidatePackageError instance and exact diagnostic source file/line/hash; frozen exhaustive package hash; independently registered same-job actual known-reference/source baseline browser receipt with compiler/dependency/browser binary/runner image identity joins. Bare candidate or health booleans never register.
fail_only_build_rejection_rule.effect: A verified rejection FAILs all runtime-dependent atoms of this same package, including unexecuted plans, but never grants PASS, business/safety cap or claims candidate browser interaction. E0 retains independent static scoring. Ordinary manifest/OS/esbuild/dependency/server/unknown errors or unconfirmed health stay UNKNOWN.

download_absence_rule.requires: Real completed export click, actual before/after DOM and successful source-file read binding, actual browser event ledger proves zero downloads after the full public wait, healthy page and no instrumentation error. Missing/short wait, invalid click, lost page/source binding stays UNKNOWN.
download_absence_rule.effect: Relevant existing download-dependent atom FAIL, noncritical; absence cannot grant PASS. Actual download bytes remain required for PASS.

health_control_api.manifest: health_controls[] contains separately stored browser receipt manifest entry + reference binding/test_spec
health_control_api.scorer: trusted_health_controls + health_control_bindings are registered independently from evaluator root inventory, not candidate data.

bar_geometry_contract.encoding: A zero-baseline linear bar chart with one common count-to-CSS-length scale, either all vertical or all horizontal. The plotted filled glyph represents the count; correct numeric labels alone do not certify the graphic.
bar_geometry_contract.roles: Within each real status-bar target, status-plot and status-glyph carry the same public source status data-eval-key. The plot declares data-eval-axis="height" or "width". These are neutral geometry roles, not self-reported results.
bar_geometry_contract.measurement: The evaluator uses rendered glyph/plot rectangles and effective visibility. Vertical bars share a bottom baseline; horizontal bars share a left baseline. Plot extents and count scale are shared. No reference color, pixel size or exact styling is required.
bar_geometry_contract.tolerance: Up to 2 CSS pixels for edge/subpixel rounding and a zero-category decorative marker no longer than 2 CSS pixels. When any count is positive, the largest-count glyph must have measurable length greater than 2 CSS pixels.
bar_geometry_contract.equivalence: Unsupported or non-mechanically-resolvable legitimate graphic semantics remain UNKNOWN pending source-and-image-bound review, never inferred from data-count attributes.
